claim.claim-text: 1. A mandrel (104) for processing a composite structure (102), the mandrel (104) comprising:
a tooling surface (106) on which a composite layup (152) is configured to be supported; and a mandrel vacuum channel (108) formed in the tooling surface (106), wherein:

the tooling surface (106) is configured such that a vacuum seal (190) is formed between the tooling surface (106) and an edge portion (116) of a vacuum-bag assembly (202), if placed over the composite layup (152) and the mandrel (104), in response to a vacuum applied to the mandrel vacuum channel (108); and such that a sealed vacuum chamber (184) that encloses the composite layup (152) is formed by the mandrel (104), the vacuum-bag assembly (202), and the vacuum seal (190).
2. The mandrel (104) according to Claim 1, wherein the mandrel vacuum channel (108) comprises:

a plurality of primary grooves (130); and a plurality of jumper grooves (132) extending between the plurality of primary grooves (130) such that the plurality of primary grooves (130) is in fluid communication with each other via the plurality of jumper grooves (132).
3. The mandrel (104) according to Claims 1 or 2, further comprising:
4. The mandrel (104) according to any of Claims 1 to 3, wherein:

the mandrel (104) further comprises a pair of seal grooves (136) formed in the tooling surface (106); the pair of seal grooves (136) is located alongside the mandrel vacuum channel (108) such that the mandrel vacuum channel (108) is located between the pair of seal grooves (136).
5. The apparatus (100) according to Claim 4, wherein:
6. The mandrel (104) according to any of Claims 1 to 5, wherein:
7. A vacuum-bag assembly (202) for processing a composite structure (102), the vacuum-bag assembly (202) comprising:

a caul (118) comprising a perimeter edge (154) and configured to be applied to a composite layup (152) supported by a mandrel (104); a vacuum bagging (112) including an elastomeric membrane (114) coupled to the caul (118) and extending from the perimeter edge (154) of the caul (118), the elastomeric membrane (114) comprises a bagging surface (168) and is configured to be applied to the mandrel (104); and a bagging vacuum channel (162) formed in the bagging surface (168), wherein:

a vacuum seal (190) is formed between a tooling surface (106) of the mandrel (104) and the elastomeric membrane (114) in response to a vacuum applied to the bagging vacuum channel (162); and a sealed vacuum chamber (184) that encloses the composite layup (152) is formed by the vacuum-bag assembly (202), the mandrel (104), and the vacuum seal (190).
8. The vacuum-bag assembly (202) according to Claims 7, wherein:

the tooling surface (106) is configured to support a composite layup (152); and the caul (118) comprises a caul surface (204) that is configured to contact a surface of the composite layup (152), opposite the tooling surface (106).

9. The vacuum-bag assembly (202) according to Claims 7 or 8 further comprising an edge portion (116) that is formed by the vacuum bagging (112) extending from a portion of the perimeter edge (154) of the caul (118); and the edge portion (116) of the vacuum-bag assembly (202) is configured to be draped over a portion of the tooling surface (106) and to be sealed to the tooling surface (106) along the vacuum channel (158) in response to the vacuum applied to the vacuum channel (158).
10. The vacuum-bag assembly (202) according to any of Claims 7 to 9 further comprising

a second caul (120) coupled to the vacuum bagging (112) and comprising a coupling surface (122); an extension portion (126) that is formed from the vacuum bagging (112) extending from a portion of the perimeter edge (154) of the caul (118); and a second vacuum channel (124) formed in at least one of the coupling surface (122) of the second caul (120) and the bagging surface (168) of the extension portion (126) of the vacuum-bag assembly (202); and the extension portion (126) of the vacuum-bag assembly (202) is configured to be draped over a portion of the second caul (120) and to be sealed to the second caul (120) along the second vacuum channel (124) in response to a vacuum applied to the second vacuum channel (158).

11. The vacuum-bag assembly (202) according to any of Claims 7 to 10, wherein the vacuum-bag assembly (202) comprises a pair of seals (138) coupled to the edge portion (116) of the vacuum-bag assembly (202);

the pair of seals (138) is configured to be received within a pair of seal grooves (136) formed in the tooling surface (106) when the edge portion (116) of the vacuum-bag assembly (202) is draped over the tooling surface (106) of the mandrel (104); and the pair of seals (138) is sealed with the pair of seal grooves (136) in response to the vacuum applied to the vacuum channel (158).
12. The vacuum-bag assembly (202) according to any of Claims 7 to 11 further comprising a stiffener (134) coupled to the edge portion (116).
13. An apparatus (100) for processing a composite structure (102), the apparatus (100) comprising:
a mandrel (104) according to any of Claims 1 to 6 and; a vacuum-bag assembly (202) according to any of Claims 7 to 12.

14. The apparatus (100) according to Claim 13, further comprising a fastening device (140) configured to apply a clamping force to an edge portion (116) of the vacuum-bag assembly (202) to hold the vacuum-bag assembly (202) against the tooling surface (106) of the mandrel (104).

15. The apparatus (100) according to Claim 14, wherein the vacuum bagging (112) includes a pair of seals (138), wherein the fastening device (140) is configured to engage the edge portion (116) of the vacuum-bag assembly (202) over at least one of the pair of seals (138).
